title: The Road That Appeared Only When He Walked | Pixel Fables #Shorts
description: An original fictional voxel fable. A traveller finds a warning where the map ends, then discovers that every step creates a new piece of the road. Story, character, map animation, island, bridge and arch are original procedural creations. All scenes are fiction, with synthetic narration and no borrowed game designs, voices or music. Technical review proposal; not published.

meta.topic: A missing road that builds itself beneath a traveller

scenes.say: The sign said: NO ROAD AHEAD. But his map showed a path.
He searched every corner. The road was missing. The map must be wrong.
So he stepped into the empty space. A square of land rose beneath his foot.
Another step. Another square. The path was not waiting to be found.
At the end, he finally understood. The map had never been finished.
It was recording every step he dared to take. Where would you walk?
